description: Creates the listing as an unpaid draft and an order for the chosen plan. It goes to editor review once paid (create_payment). Write plain facts; no hype words, no claims you can’t back.

advanced.description: Optional details shown on the listing page. Pass only what you know from the product’s own site; each section you pass replaces that section. company_name, founded_year and specs are checked by an editor.

audience.description: Who it is for, short groups.

price.description: As on the pricing page, USD, e.g. "$19/mo or $15/mo billed yearly".

specs.description: Category figures by key (see list_categories: spec_fields of the main category).

specs_source.description: https page on the product’s own site that states the specs.

api_key.description: Your infobro API key, if it is not set as the Authorization header of this connection.

description.description: 120-4000 characters, markdown allowed: what it does, for whom, key features, pricing.

extra_categories.description: More category slugs (Listing: 2 in total, Pro: 5).

logo_url.description: https link to a square logo.

plan.description: The plan the owner chose, or the one you picked because they asked you to decide.

platforms.description: web, ios, android, macos, windows, linux, chrome-extension, api, slack, vscode, self-hosted

pricing_model.description: FREE, FREEMIUM, FREE_TRIAL, PAID or CONTACT.

starting_price.description: Cheapest paid plan, USD per month.

name: submit_tool
title: Submit a new listing
